I'm back on the order side. No need to email the video anywhere. Hal has already confirmed your BS-2 as defective from the tests you described, so the return is now with the team for approval. They'll confirm it by email shortly.

I'm sorry your earlier ticket sat without an answer for days. You shouldn't have had to chase us for this.

When their email arrives, you can reply to it with the video. One question for the return: has the unit ever been overclocked?
No, I did not alter timing in any way. I did use the Harlo firmware. It was stable for a couple of weeks.

Thanks, that's what we needed. Running the stock Harlo firmware at its default settings is normal use, so it doesn't affect the return.

Your BS-2 return is with the team for review now, along with Hal's findings and your test results. They'll confirm by email shortly, and you can reply to that email with the video.

Please keep the unit unplugged until then. Is there anything else I can help with while you wait?
You're welcome. Watch your inbox for the team's email about the return, and keep the BS-2 unplugged until then. Thanks for all the testing you did.
No problem, thank you for looking at my notes. I do appreciate it.
